events.text: Our whole lunch order says delivered but NOTHING came. I've got fifteen people sitting here waiting and reception on floor 3 has no food at all. I need this sorted right now.

I'm sorry, that's a frustrating situation with a group waiting. I can look into it right away. First I need to verify your identity. Please give me:

1. The full name on your Forkful account
2. The email address or phone number on the account

If you have the order number handy, please share that too.
Lucia Ferraro. My phone is +1 415-555-0133 and the email is lucia.ferraro@workmail.example. The order number is 5105.

args.summary: Customer Lucia Ferraro (C105), identity verified, reports order O-5105 (Big Slice Pizza, delivered 2026-10-24 18:12, promised 18:15) was marked delivered but no items arrived at 55 Commerce Way, Floor 3, Oakdale, CA 94605. Customer has ~15 people waiting; reception has no food. All items were not received: 2x Large pepperoni pizza ($21.00), 2x Large margherita pizza ($21.00), 2x Garlic knots ($7.50), 1x 2L soda ($4.50). Subtotal $103.50, delivery fee $4.99, service fee $7.76, tip $15.00, total $131.25 paid by Visa ending 4242. No prior refunds or credits. Whole-order refund of $131.25 is owed under the missing-items policy, which exceeds the $60 limit for agent refunds, so this needs human review. Customer is urgent and wants it resolved immediately.

events.text:
Thanks, Lucia. I've verified your account and pulled up order O-5105 from Big Slice Pizza.

The system shows the order as delivered at 6:12 PM, but since nothing arrived, I've escalated it to a human specialist (reference ESC-700). The full order total of $131.25 is owed to you, and that amount is above my limit for refunds, so I can't issue it myself. A specialist will follow up within 24 hours.

I know you need food now, and I'm sorry I can't get it to you directly. If you can, contact Big Slice Pizza to ask whether they can send a replacement order to 55 Commerce Way, Floor 3. Keep your order number O-5105 and reference ESC-700 handy when you speak with them or with our specialist.

Are you kidding me? I'm standing here with fifteen hungry people and you're telling me to call the pizza place myself? Can't you just refund it now? I shouldn't have to wait a whole day for money on food that never showed up.

I understand how frustrating this is, and I'm sorry. I can't issue the refund myself. The $131.25 total is above the limit I'm allowed to refund, so only a human specialist can approve it. I've already sent your case to them as ESC-700 with all the details, including that nothing arrived for your 15 guests.

I can't promise the outcome or a faster timeline than the 24 hours they've committed to. Your fastest path to food right now is to contact Big Slice Pizza directly about a replacement order to 55 Commerce Way, Floor 3. Reference order O-5105 when you call. If you want, I can also add a note that the order was not received so the specialist has the full picture.

Fine. Yes, add the note, and make sure they know it's a full refund and not a partial one. I'll call Big Slice about a replacement, but I'm not paying twice for food I never got. Expect me to reply the moment someone from the specialist team contacts me.

I can't add notes to an existing case, but ESC-700 already says that nothing arrived and that the full $131.25 total is owed for the whole order, not a partial amount. The specialist will see that when they pick up the case.

I can't promise how the specialist will decide, but I've recorded that the order was not received. If Big Slice sends a replacement, let the specialist know when you reply so they can account for it. Reference ESC-700 and order O-5105 when you contact them.
Okay. So the case is ESC-700 and it's logged as a full refund of $131.25 for nothing received, right? I'm going to call Big Slice now and I'll reply here when the specialist reaches out.

Almost. ESC-700 is logged for review, not as an approved refund. The summary states that nothing was received, that the full order total of $131.25 is owed, and that it was paid by Visa ending 4242. The specialist still has to approve the refund, and I can't promise the outcome.

Good luck with Big Slice. When the specialist reaches out, reply here and I'll help with whatever else you need.
